comments.body: From my experience as a recent ETH CS MSc grad: 100k should be doable, 120k is rarer but still happens, for >150k you need to go to big tech or finance (HFT) companies. However, the job market is tough at the moment. For every opening at big tech companies in Zurich, there are around 300-500 applications. Furthermore, most current openings are for senior positions.
comments.author: human3483933883
